# name: Xibalba summons the twins; the louse, the toad, the snake and the falcon
# title: Que quicot chicut xe bec echaahel
# fols: fols. 22r–23v
Que quicot chicut xe bec echaahel, pa hom; naht cu xe chaahic qui tuquel; xqui mez ri hom qui cahau.

Ta xquita cu vloc rahaual Xibalba: “Apa china chiri mi xu tiquiba chic etzanem pa ca vi? Ma pa que quixbic que nicnot vloc? Ma pa xe cam ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu, xrah qui nimarizah quib chi ca vach? He cu itaca chic,” xeꜭha chic ri Hun Came, Vvcub Came, conohel ahauab.

Xe taco vloc; xeꜭha cut chire qui zamahel: “Quixꜭha, quix oponic: Que petoc, queꜭha ahauab; varal tah coh chaah vi cuꜭ; vvcubix coh etzanic, quecha ahauab; quixꜭha quix oponic,” xevꜭhax cut ri zamahel.

Ta xe pe cut, nima hoc cu qui be ri ꜭaholab chi cochoch, ca tocol chi cochoch; xa cu yacal ri zamahel xopon ruꜭ catit. Are cut que chahic ta xul canoc vzamahel Xibalba.

“Quitzih que petic, quecha ri ahauab,” xeꜭha cut ri vzamahel Xibalba. Ta xchoye cu canoc qui quih cumal ri vzamahel Xibalba: “Vvcubix que tzelavachixic,” xuꜭhax canoc Xmucane. “Vꜩ bala, xque be tacoc, ix zamahel,” xꜭha ri atit. Xe be curi zamahel, xe tzalihic.

Ta xquiz cut vꜭux ri atit: “Naqui xchin vchah qui taquic ri viy? Mavi quitzih ri Xibalba? Xa quehe rulic zamahel oher, ta xe be camoc ri qui cahau,” xꜭha ri catit, ꜫuz choc pa ha vtuquel.

Catecut xcah vlo hun vꜭ chu cayac; cate cu xu chap acanoc, ta xu ya cut pu cab; chi malmat ib curi vꜭ xbinic. “At viy, chavah tah ca nu taco, que be ta a taca ri viy pa hom?” xuꜭhax ri vꜭ. Ta xbec taconel: “Mi xul zamahel ruꜭ ivatit; caꜭha: Cat oponic; vvcubix cut que oponic, cacha vzamahel Xibalba, caꜭha ivatit,” caꜭha, xuꜭhax ri vꜭ.

Ta xbec; chi malmat cut xbec. Cubul curi ꜭahol pa be, Tamazul vbi, ri xpec. “Apa cat be vi?” ꜭha cu ri xpec chire vꜭ. “Ꜭo ba nu ꜩih chi nu pam; quin be cuꜭ ꜭaholab,” xꜭha ri vꜭ chire Tamazul. “Vꜩ bala, ma ba cat anaic, ca vilo,” xuꜭhax cu vꜭ ta rumal xpec. “Ma chavah ca nu bico? Chavila na pe quin anic va; xcoh opon chanim.” “Vꜩ bala,” xꜭha ri vꜭ chirech xpec.

Catecut ta xrictaxic rumal xpec. Chi bec nah curi xpec ta xbec, chi mavi ca anic. Catecut ta xu cul chicut hun nima cumatz, Zaquicaz vbi. “Apa cat be vi, at Tamazul ꜭahol?” xuꜭhax chic ri xpec rumal Zaquicaz. “In zamahel; ꜭo nu ꜩih chi nu pam,” xꜭha chicut xpec chire cumatz. “Ma ba cat anic, ca vilo; in ta on xquin opon chanim,” xꜭha cu cumatz chire xpec. “Cat oho,” xuꜭhaxic.

Catecu xbic chic ri xpec rumal Zaquicaz; ta xu cam ri recha cumatz, que bico v xpec vacamic. Chan curi cumatz ta xbec; xculutah chi vi cut ri cumatz rumal vac, nima ꜩiquin; xbic chi vi ri cumatz rumal vac. Catepu xopon ri chuvi hom; ta xu cam recha ri xic, que tio v cumatz pa tac huyub.

Ta xopon puch ri vac, xꜭhacachob chuvi v ꜩuꜩil hom; que quicot curi Hunahpu, Xbalanque, que chaahic. Ta xopon cut ri vac, ta xoc curi vac: “Vacco, vacco,” xꜭha v oquibal, “vacco.” “Naqui pa ri choquic? Peta ca vvb,” xeꜭha.

Catepuch xqui vvbah ri vac; qui cu tacal vbac vvb chu bac vvach; chi ꜩelet cut xcah vloc. Quitzih vi cut xbe qui chapa; cate xqui ꜩonoh: “Hupa a petic?” xeꜭha chire vac. “Ꜭo ba nu ꜩih chi nu pam; chi cunah ta na vbac nu vach nabe, catecut xchin biyh,” xꜭha ri vac. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.

Cate xquelezah zcaquin rih quic ri chaah, xqui coh chi vvach ri vac; loꜩ quic xu binaah cumal. Libah chicut xcachoh cumal; vꜩ chic vmucubal ri vac xuxic. “Chabiyh cut,” xeꜭha chire vac.

Catecut xu xavah nima cumatz. “Caꜭhau oc,” xeꜭha chic chire cumatz. “Ve,” xꜭha chicut, ta xu xauah chi xpec. “Naquipa a taquiquil ca ꜩihon oc?” xuchax chicuri xpec. “Ꜭo ba nu ꜩih chi nu pam,” xꜭha chicuri xpec.

Catecut xu tih, xa bic, mahabi xu xauah; xa quehe chu caxꜩ vchi chu tiho; xma ꜭo vi chu xauah. Catecut xrah chaiic cumal ꜭaholab: “At ꜭaxtoy,” xuꜭhaxic; ta xiic vvarachac chi acan; xcah cu baquil vvarachac chi acan. Xu tih chicut; xa quehe chu chub vchi.

Catepuch xqui rech vchi ri xpec; xrech cumal ꜭaholab; xqui zucah pu chi. Xa cu nacal ri vꜭ chava re xpec, xa pu chi ꜭo vi; mana xu bico, xa quehe xa bic. Quehe cut xchacatah vi ri xpec; mavi calah vvach recha xqui yao; ruꜭ mavi ꜭhanic; xa v chac cumatz xuxic.

“Caꜩihon oc,” xuꜭhax chicut ri vꜭ; ta xu biyh cu vꜩih: “Caꜭha ri ivatit, ix ꜭaholab: He a taca; xul tacol que ca pe chi Xibalba, vzamahel Hun Came, Vvcub Came: Vvcubix que vlic varal, coh chaah vi; chi pe ri quetzabal, quic, bate, pachcab, quum; are chi caztah vvach varal, queꜭha ahauab. Xul quitzih, cacha ri ivatit. Ta xi petic. Quitzih caꜭha ri ivatit; coquic, ca ziquinic ivatit; xi petic.” “Ma quitzih?” xeꜭha cut ꜭaholab chi qui ꜭux, ta xqui tao. Huzu xe petic; xe opon cut ruꜭ catit; xa e pixabai chire catit xebec.

“Hona, ix catit; xa oh pixabay ive. Vae cute retal ca ꜩih xchi ca canah: huhun xchi ca tic chire va ah; chu nicahal cochoch xchi ca tic vi. Are retal ca camic, ve chi chaquihic: Mi pa xe camic, quixꜭha, ta chi chaquihic. Ve cut ta chi pe vtux: E pa cazlic, quixꜭha cut. Ix catit, ix pu ca chuch, mix oquic; ꜭo retal ca ꜩih ca canahic ivuꜭ,” xeꜭha.

Ta xebec; hun xu tic Hunahpu, hun chicu xticou Xbalanque; xa pa ha xu tic vi; mana pa huyub tah, mana ipu pa rax vleu tah, xa pa chaquih vleu chu nicahal vpa cochoch xqui tic vi canoc.
